headline: Monthly Crowdfunding Investment Falls 36% After ISR Withholding
summary: Monthly crowdfunding investment fell 36% after platforms began automatically withholding 20% income tax (ISR) in 2026. Investors previously declared and paid the tax themselves.
why: Crowdfunding platforms connect small investors with businesses and projects, and tax rules affect net returns. Changes in withholding can shift investor participation.
original_headline: La inversión mensual en crowdfunding cae 36% tras retención de ISR
